entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: The scalar-comparison family has explicit root and existing-plan mixedFloatOnly registrations. lowerComparisonRoot checks root authority before loading the original mixed union; finishScalarComparison checks root authority for its canonical boundary and existing-plan authority only for a live Mixed input at its guarded boundary. Both production sites are registered, while ordinary histogram-only inputs do not acquire a mixed-plan dependency. Missing registrations and unsupported modes arise only from internal misuse or deliberate authority-test mutation, not query-controlled policy values. Computed scalar comparisons remain under foldSyntheticVectorBinary's separate vector-comparison authority.
